title: PRESSER | Dom Decker - Fall Ball Wrap-Up (11-16-26)
text: How'd your fall go? >> Uh, it was pretty solid. Um, just, you know, kind of just like any other fall for me. Just trying to figure out, you know, what's working, what's not, and, uh, trying to stick to my process throughout the whole fall. I've had, you know, this my fifth one in total. Um, and obviously every fall is different, but it's kind of the same in the fact of, uh, trying to, you know, get my body to get back to going, getting, uh, everything going how it should be. So, I mean, it was it was a good fall. Good uh good to get back out there and uh learn a lot about our our team this year. So, it was a lot of fun. >> So, what was working and what wasn't? >> Um it was uh just kind of, you know, same thing about like same thing kind of last year, just uh just balls in play, you know, not striking out a lot, low chase rate. That's kind of the main things I focused on this year is more doing what I do well at the highest level that I can. Um, and I thought that went really well this fall. Um, and I think last fall I tried a little too much on focusing on driving the ball, you know, getting balls out of yard and um, those will I kind of learned this year those will come. Just uh, focusing on what I do well and doing it the best I can. >> You were uh, already in this stadium before you got here because we remember that. like comparing last fall and you may have just done some of that but last fall to this fall for you just from a comfort zone and being here and >> Oh yeah, >> kind of getting used to things. >> Yeah, it's uh it's been a lot more you know comfortable on my end just knowing the system um being here for a whole year um learning how to play under coach B. Um and that just it makes it a lot easier going into this fall and just allowing me to really try to get better this fall. Um instead of where last year it kind of felt trying to prove myself. Um, and this year I could really focus on just trying to get better and uh was definitely a lot more comfortable going into this fall. >> You're kind of known for your knowledge of the strike zone. I guess with that in mind, you know, just what are your thoughts on ABS? >> Uh, I think it's going to be really cool. Um, I think teams are going to have to learn how to manage it. Um, and how to uh how it works for each team. I think it's going to be different. Um, and we saw that kind of in our pizza bowl. We both both teams had three challenges and then we kind of had free reign to do whatever we wanted with them and they were gone halfway through the game. So, it's just kind of trying to figure out how to manage that. Um like whether it's going to be outcome based, we were allowed to challenge something like that. Um I think that's going to be the the hardest part for teams, but I think it's going to be a really cool addition. >> Last year you came out of nowhere and hit how many home runs? >> 10 nine 10 I think. >> Yes. >> And you hadn't hit one before? >> Yeah. Yeah. What was the difference in the strength? >> Um, well, I last year I really worked hard with uh Carella, our strength guy, and um he really helped me just move my body how it's supposed to and build those areas of my of of strength up that I haven't done before. So, that came I mean that caused a lot of the the strength and power. And then working with Clim too, little tweaks with Clim, learning how to backspin it a little better. Um, it's something I struggled with kind of my whole life was back spinning the ball. So, um, working with him helped with that a lot. And, uh, again, the home runs once I figured that out, they just kind of came. So, >> what about the competition this fall at second or you know, I saw you some at third. >> Yeah. >> Um, >> um, yeah. I mean, we just be be likes to move a lot of people around and, you know, see what works, see what doesn't. Um, and I think he's he he did it last fall too and he I think he's always kind of done it where just wants to make everybody comfortable in different positions in case it comes to that. Um, and it's just yeah trying to do my best at getting comfortable at every different position and um being wherever they need me to. Do you and Hunter remind people that you've been to Omaha twice and maybe some of them hadn't. [snorts] But seriously, uh, you know, that was special last year getting there, but you'd been there before. Just talk about, you know, not maybe looking too far ahead. Talk about Omaha now, but I mean, your coach never had a shi away from those kind of goals. >> Yeah. No, it was definitely a really special group last year and a special moment for all of us and like me included, it was it was awesome to go back. Um, and I think this it's not too it's not early to talk about cuz that's our I mean that's our goal every year. Um, and everything we do each day is to prepare us to go to Omaha and um, and win in Omaha and um, so I'm excited about this team. I think we got a really good team and I'm excited to have the chance to maybe go back and do some damage. >> Thank you, brother. >> Yes, sir. Thank you.
